title: Rabbi Levi bar Rabbi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites this form in Bamidbar Rabbah 15:10 and the Old Tanchuma, Beha’alotekha 6. He concludes without doubt that exactly one word is missing after bar Rabbi, or that the expression is an abbreviation.

notes.text: Hyman leaves the missing word or the intended expansion after bar Rabbi unidentified.

The saved whole Torat Emet Bamidbar Rabbah15:10 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Levi bar Rabbi and the heavenly menorah teaching. It supplies no further word after bar Rabbi. Hyman’s diagnosis retains without doubt, exactly one word, and the alternative abbreviation explanation, all attributed to him. Old Tanchuma Beha’alotekha6 is not newly inspected, and a finite search does not establish universal absence of a fuller form.

The menorah homily in Bamidbar Rabbah 15:10 names Rabbi Levi bar Rabbi, and the corresponding passage in the standard Tanchuma, Beha’alotekha 6, reads Rabbi Levi Berabbi. In Buber’s edition, the corresponding homily is in §11 and names Rabbi Levi. Buber’s §6 concerns Aaron and the tribe of Levi. Hyman’s conjecture leaves the missing word or expansion unspecified.
